chr15_tuff3r: The quartermaster asked Leopold "Bones" Tuff to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.

Leopold "Bones" Tuff was on wiring party in no man's land. Every time a flare went up he froze like a scarecrow. It worked. A letter for Leopold "Bones" Tuff came with a photograph. Leopold "Bones" Tuff looked at it for a long time and said nothing.
Leopold began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else.
davidk513: Day 9: Teodor Davidk reached Q-F9 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Teodor Davidk wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Teodor Davidk and Rafael "Brick" Firekeyboard cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button. Grey Mill is lost. Teodor Davidk heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Teodor Davidk's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.
A second spoon disappeared. Teodor Davidk searched the washing area and found a gap behind the board where everyone left cutlery to dry.
Teodor Davidk lifted the board. The gap contained seven spoons, a button and a pencil people had blamed the quartermaster for losing.
Teodor Davidk lifted the trench periscope and found a spider across the mirror. For one startled second, the enemy seemed enormous.
A flare lit Grey Mill like noon. Teodor Davidk counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.
The recovered spoons were laid out for collection. Teodor Davidk took the original and repaired the gap before the next meal.
A muddy dog crawled into Q-F9 through the wire. Teodor gave it half his bread. It has not left his side since. The men call it Lump.
fynn_witcombe: Jonas Witcombe signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at P-F12 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Jonas Witcombe looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Jonas Witcombe checked the fire step after the shelling. The wall had moved, and the spot where he always put his foot was gone. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached P-F12 with the rations. Jonas Witcombe ate while listening to the revised orders.
On a quiet night Jonas Witcombe (Concord) and Ivo Racoon (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there.

Jonas Witcombe was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at P-F12. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Norbert Cos of the Hegemony (@panco_cos). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Jonas Witcombe fell at P-F12 and never moved again. Shot by Norbert Cos of the Hegemony (@panco_cos).
The House of Witcombe sent another. Zeno Witcombe, father of Jonas Witcombe, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Zeno Witcombe worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost.
Zeno Witcombe borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless.
Zeno Witcombe (Concord) and Silas Menezes (Hegemony) spotted the same abandoned cart near the Hanging Bridge. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was.
Zeno Witcombe carried in Pip, who lied about his age to enlist. Pip kept asking whether his mother would be told.
Zeno sewed a torn coat before sewing a torn man. The man did not mind. He was asleep.
grant.hemana: Pavel Hemana was a clockmaker in Dunmarrow until the posters went up. He came to R-S14 with a lock of hair in a matchbox, and within a day the whole squad knew that he writes everything down in a tiny notebook.
Pavel Hemana cleaned grit from the rifle bolt with a scrap of cloth. The scrap was once the clean part of a shirt.

No rifles, only shovels and knives. Pavel Hemana dropped into the Hegemony trench by a dugout door and met Matthias Universal coming out. It was over in seconds. (@chamra_universal) Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Pavel Hemana kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

A round went through Pavel Hemana's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Bastian "Mud" Hi of the Hegemony (@hi691812). The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Pavel Hemana answered to number 514. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Pavel Hemana wrote to a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

A bullet struck Pavel Hemana below the ribs at R-S14. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Clement Hs of the Hegemony (@13_h.s_54). Pavel Hemana was killed on watch at R-S14. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Clement Hs of the Hegemony (@13_h.s_54).
Edmund "Button" Hemana joined R-S14 under the shadow of Pavel Hemana's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
A new recruit would not eat with the others. Edmund "Button" Hemana left a place at the end of the bench and said nothing about it.

Edmund "Button" Hemana was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-S14. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Ivo "Shadow" Bucko of the Hegemony (@markus__bucko).
Edmund "Button" Hemana came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Edmund "Button" Hemana in the open at R-S14. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Cyril Otroserhuman of the Hegemony (@otroserhumanoo). The orderlies scrubbed a bed in the hospital dugout and called for Edmund "Button" Hemana. He was asleep before they set him down. Edmund "Button" Hemana is out of danger. Still bedridden, still bandaged, but out of danger.
Edmund "Button" Hemana spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice.
For days Edmund was too weak to sit up on the stretcher. This morning he sat up, then stood, then asked for his rifle.
hi691812: Bastian "Mud" Hi took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Bastian "Mud" Hi during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Bastian "Mud" Hi had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Pavel Hemana was grazed. Bastian "Mud" Hi saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at R-C11 and fired once. Clement Metropolitan was grazed. The clerk counted the names twice. Bastian "Mud" Hi is number 881 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Bastian "Mud" Hi shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
The water jacket hissed as Bastian "Mud" Hi fired across no man's land. When the gun went quiet, Oskar Elementalher was grazed.
A loose thread in Bastian "Mud" Hi's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain.
Bastian "Mud" Hi won a week of rum at cards from a lance corporal in R-C11. The lance corporal wants a rematch.
Bastian "Mud" Hi tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.
Bastian "Mud" Hi fired three short bursts at nothing to keep the enemy honest. The enemy fired three back to keep him honest too.

Bastian "Mud" Hi had just lit a cigarette at R-C11 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Karel Sperring of the Concord (@sean_sperring).
Bastian had been fine for a day. Then the leg swelled, and he was carried off in a hurry.
internetmang: "You're late," said the corporal when Bram "Smokes" Internetmang arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
Blackwater Canal has been won. Bram "Smokes" Internetmang listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Bram "Smokes" Internetmang felt a hard tug at his hip at R-R7. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Arno "Mud" Bobkin of the Concord (@bob.bobkin.921). Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Bram "Smokes" Internetmang shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Bram "Smokes" Internetmang no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Bram "Smokes" Internetmang gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.

A round went through the rim of Bram "Smokes" Internetmang's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Clement "Brick" Nathanielenz of the Concord (@nathanielenzo_073).

A sniper's bullet hit Bram "Smokes" Internetmang at R-R7. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Karel Pavla of the Concord (@pavla.9_). A single shot at R-R7. Bram "Smokes" Internetmang sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Karel Pavla of the Concord (@pavla.9_).
Ulrich Internetmang arrived carrying the family name of Bram "Smokes" Internetmang. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Ulrich Internetmang across the shin at R-R7. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Gustav "Mud" Stefano of the Concord (@faccio.stefano).
Ulrich Internetmang walked back up the communication trench to R-R7, slower than before, but on his own feet.
Ulrich was reaching for a canteen at R-R7 when a round tore the strap in two. It also tore a line across his hand. Shot by Emil "Rabbit" Hill of the Concord (@nathan_hill2308).
lynallwarrior51: The draft reached S-S3 on Day 8. Karel Lynallwarrio was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
Karel Lynallwarrio cut Marek "Lucky" Chase's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short.

A bullet clipped Karel Lynallwarrio's helmet at S-S3 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Otto Dunkmyanactu of the Hegemony (@dunkmyanactual). Karel Lynallwarrio did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Karel Lynallwarrio fired back. Yann Nilsiiboy was grazed. The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In S-S3, Karel Lynallwarrio listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Karel Lynallwarrio was hit in the foot through his boot at S-S3. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Gustav Foad of the Hegemony (@foad666x). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Karel Lynallwarrio fell at S-S3 and never moved again. Shot by Gustav Foad of the Hegemony (@foad666x).

Tobias Lynallwarrio joined S-S3 under the shadow of Karel Lynallwarrio's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one. The clerk counted the names twice. Tobias Lynallwarrio is number 537 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Tobias Lynallwarrio looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Tobias Lynallwarrio in the open at S-S3. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Oskar Londonz of the Hegemony (@londonz_29). Tobias Lynallwarrio was killed outright at S-S3, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Oskar Londonz of the Hegemony (@londonz_29).
The House of Lynallwarrio sent Clement Lynallwarrio after Tobias Lynallwarrio. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
Clement Lynallwarrio rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Silas Hansen was grazed at the far edge of no man's land.

A round went through Clement Lynallwarrio's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Cyril Rttr of the Hegemony (@19rttr97). Clement Lynallwarrio had kept the gun aimed at the enemy supply path for days. Tonight the supply party came, and Felix Austin was badly wounded.

Clement Lynallwarrio was carrying water up to S-S3 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Clement Lynallwarrio did not. Shot by Oskar Austin of the Hegemony (@_austin.w._). A single shot at S-S3. Clement Lynallwarrio sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Oskar Austin of the Hegemony (@_austin.w._).
The papers connected Pavel Lynallwarrio to Clement Lynallwarrio. The men took longer to learn Pavel Lynallwarrio's own habits, but they made the effort.

A round came through the loophole Pavel Lynallwarrio was watching at S-S3 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Matthias "Lucky" Princeblood of the Hegemony (@princeblood84).
The bearers moved Pavel Lynallwarrio's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule.
Pavel survived the wound and the waiting. He is back at S-S3, and still will not talk about the nights outside the aid post.
nothing_va1: "You're late," said the corporal when Valentin Nothing arrived on Day 11. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

Valentin Nothing was promoted to Lance Corporal. The first request addressed to the new rank concerned a blocked drain. A letter from home reached Valentin Nothing before dusk. Valentin Nothing read it twice and slept a little easier.

Valentin Nothing tried to sketch a horse from memory. The dugout agreed it was a very good dog. A letter from home reached Valentin Nothing before dusk. Valentin Nothing read it twice and slept a little easier.

Valentin Nothing agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age. A letter from home reached Valentin Nothing before dusk. Valentin Nothing read it twice and slept a little easier.

Valentin Nothing had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any. A letter from home reached Valentin Nothing before dusk. Valentin Nothing read it twice and slept a little easier.

Valentin Nothing jumped into the Hegemony trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Gustav Jackpriv. The Hegemony medics will be busy. (@jackpriv11g) In the dark of the Hegemony trench Valentin Nothing hit Gideon "Whistle" Colepatriqui with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@colepatriquin) Valentin Nothing came back from the raid with mud to the eyebrows and an enemy helmet as a souvenir. Valentin Nothing was on the dawn watch at V-F5 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Valentin Nothing was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Severin "Spark" Louieeeisoka of the Hegemony (@louieeeisokaywiththis). Valentin Nothing found a letter on the fire step, left by the runner. Valentin Nothing read it while the kettle boiled.

Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Valentin Nothing is whole again, or near enough for the line. A letter for Valentin Nothing came all the way from home in nine days. Valentin Nothing counted them on the envelope.

The artist tried again while Valentin read a letter. The new portrait was better, though the ears became the subject of discussion. The letter for Valentin was mostly about the weather at home. Valentin read that part twice too.
ollie081224: Albin Ollie introduced himself as a brewer from Kesselby. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice. Victory at Grey Mill. Albin Ollie let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Albin Ollie found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
Albin Ollie's menu now circulates before supper. Someone has requested a wine list. The water bucket has been given a vintage.
The parcel for Albin Ollie contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.
An officer asked who was writing the menus. Albin Ollie admitted it and waited. The officer asked for a copy to send home.

Albin Ollie was on the dawn watch at P-F5 when the Concord raiders came. A club, a shout, and Albin Ollie was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Isidor Ksie of the Concord (@itz_br00ksie). A letter for Albin Ollie came with a photograph. Albin Ollie looked at it for a long time and said nothing.
Albin Ollie's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it. The letter for Albin Ollie ended with 'come home soon'. Albin Ollie read the last line more than the rest.
Albin retired the menu after running out of grand names for turnips. The final card reads 'The Usual', underlined twice.
tacomeister: Nobody asked Nils "Mud" Tacomeister why he came. Nobody in Q-F23 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

Pavel Emanvince and Nils "Mud" Tacomeister share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship. A letter from home reached Nils "Mud" Tacomeister before dusk. Nils "Mud" Tacomeister read it twice and slept a little easier. The transfer made Nils "Mud" Tacomeister a runner. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Nils "Mud" Tacomeister helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

A single shot from across the wire hit Nils "Mud" Tacomeister in the thigh at Q-F23. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Henrik Ami of the Concord (@ami_ne_dz13). A letter from home reached Nils "Mud" Tacomeister before dusk. Nils "Mud" Tacomeister read it twice and slept a little easier.

The medics would not give up on Nils "Mud" Tacomeister. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to Q-F23 today. A letter from home reached Nils "Mud" Tacomeister before dusk. Nils "Mud" Tacomeister read it twice and slept a little easier.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Nils "Mud" Tacomeister was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at Q-F23. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. A letter from home reached Nils "Mud" Tacomeister before dusk. Nils "Mud" Tacomeister read it twice and slept a little easier.

Nils "Mud" Tacomeister was hit in the hip at Q-F23. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Leopold Wihanholtzha of the Concord (@wihanholtzhauzen). A letter from home reached Nils "Mud" Tacomeister before dusk. Nils "Mud" Tacomeister read it twice and slept a little easier.
There was no room for Nils "Mud" Tacomeister. He died in the night under a borrowed coat, a few yards from a bed that never came free.
Jakub Tacomeister took the same post at Q-F23 where Nils "Mud" Tacomeister stood. He found his father's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.

The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Jakub Tacomeister fired, and Dietrich Veryprdy was grazed. A letter reached Jakub Tacomeister in the rain. The ink ran a little, but every word that mattered was still there.

Jakub gave Viktor Ghost the last match in the trench. Viktor used it to light a candle so that Jakub could finish a letter. Jakub read the letter from the girl next door twice and then put it away, to keep it for later.
the_real_yanez: They issued Bastian Yanez a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a child's drawing of a horse in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
The section held a competition for the worst joke. Bastian Yanez won before reaching the end of his entry.
Blast from a trench mortar threw Bastian Yanez against the trench wall at V-F22. Ringing ears, a split lip, and no intention of leaving.
Bastian Yanez rejoined the squad at V-F22. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
A bucket appeared above the Hegemony parapet at Calvary Farm. Bastian Yanez fired. Quentin "Crow" Bannerlordsa pulled the bucket down. Later a sign went up: 'Water costs enough already.'
Bastian took stock of his pockets: string, crumbs, a pencil and no sign of the button he was looking for.
totally_geeked_fish: At the depot, Matthias "Brick" Fish had practised answering to his name. At S-C16, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.

Matthias "Brick" Fish fired short bursts at the gap in the enemy wire, the way the sergeant taught. Tobias Adammyers was grazed trying to cross it. A bullet went through Matthias "Brick" Fish's sleeve at S-C16 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Dorian Noahz of the Concord (@702.noahz). The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Matthias "Brick" Fish helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

A single shot from across the wire hit Matthias "Brick" Fish in the thigh at S-C16. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Isidor Jacksondeehr of the Concord (@jacksondeehring). A single shot at S-C16. Matthias "Brick" Fish sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Isidor Jacksondeehr of the Concord (@jacksondeehring).

Bastian "Shadow" Fish had heard about Matthias "Brick" Fish's courage. At S-C16, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting. The clerk counted the names twice. Bastian "Shadow" Fish is number 989 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Bastian "Shadow" Fish watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Roland Lovelightnin fixed the strap on Bastian "Shadow" Fish's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
Bastian "Shadow" Fish put an empty tin under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal.
Bastian "Shadow" Fish fell asleep on watch. Otto "Brick" Valsteinne took over without waking Shadow, and told the sergeant nothing.
Bastian "Shadow" Fish (Hegemony) and Dietrich Realpayton (Concord) spotted the same abandoned cart near the Brickworks. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was.
Bastian "Shadow" Fish flashed a lamp signal to the battery behind the ridge. The answer came back: a single word, misspelled.
The bread was divided with a ruler. Bastian "Shadow" Fish received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler.
Bastian was asked for a message to the colonel. It took a minute to send and four hours to be answered.
totally_normal_ozzy: The sergeant gave Zeno "Shadow" Ozzy a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 8 or any other.
Norbert "Shadow" Peakharmon and Zeno "Shadow" Ozzy tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Zeno "Shadow" Ozzy watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Zeno "Shadow" Ozzy saw a hare run the whole length of no man's land and nobody on either side fired at it. A letter from home found Zeno "Shadow" Ozzy before the night shift. Zeno "Shadow" Ozzy folded it small and kept it close. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Zeno "Shadow" Ozzy answered to number 566. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Zeno "Shadow" Ozzy during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Zeno "Shadow" Ozzy thought about a grandmother who prays for both armies on sentry tonight, and the night felt a little shorter.
Across the wire at Lantern Hill, Otto "Smokes" Ojmcfall of the Concord held up a sign: 'How is your coffee?' Zeno "Shadow" Ozzy of the Hegemony held up a sign back: 'Worse than yours.'
Zeno "Shadow" Ozzy lost a boot in the trench. Wendel Jesus found it, stuffed it with dry socks, and gave it back without a word.
Zeno "Shadow" Ozzy and Konrad Goldjacky carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.
Zeno "Shadow" Ozzy found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.

A round came through the loophole Zeno "Shadow" Ozzy was watching at R-S15 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Jakub Beniiioz of the Concord (@beniiioz). The letter for Zeno "Shadow" Ozzy was mostly about the weather at home. Zeno "Shadow" Ozzy read that part twice too.
Zeno survived the wound and the waiting. He is back at R-S15, and still will not talk about the nights outside the aid post.
